test_coverage_gaps.description: No explicit FLAT/UP verdict test in cpmRoasAnalysis.test.ts.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: One of the 9 CPM trend x ROAS trend copy/tone branches is only indirectly covered by code review, so a text/tone regression there could slip.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Seven active days with cpm fixed at 5 and roas increasing from 2.0 to 3.0; expect tone positive and text containing "שיפור באופטימיזציה".

test_coverage_gaps.description: No boundary test for exactly 5 active current days.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The public contract says 5 active days is the minimum; tests cover fewer than 5 and many 7-day cases, but not the exact threshold.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Five rows with cpm > 0 and mixed roas including 0; expect hasData true and details.n = 5.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No non-finite numeric input guard tests for NaN or Infinity in cpm/roas.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Current production call sites derive finite numbers, but malformed upstream rows could turn details or categorization into misleading flat reads.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Series containing Number.NaN roas or Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY cpm; define whether the analyzer should filter, return hasData false, or throw.
